format: weights_only-safe Tensor and JSON/primitive containers only; no model object, TorchVersion, NumPy ndarray object, SimpleNamespace or arbitrary pickle class; no unsafe allowlist widening.
immutable_identity: source manifest/seal and exact neural/new-driver hashes
author commit and full primitive recipe
runtime versions, exact source/binary files and actual deterministic/precision flags/device
tensor_state: all model parameters and buffers including learned local/global gates and boundary R/S/B
full Adam param groups, ordered parameter-name ownership, state tensors and step counters
requires_grad per name and current gradients including None for inactive entries
mutable_python_state: native model._global for every native instance
boundary.core._global and outer family.global_stage if a new outer owner exists; require all flags consistent
RNG: selected-device CUDA RNG Tensor when GPU is admitted
factor construction before/after states and training stream provenance
selection_and_clocks: one persistent best VAL correct_count/count across both stages
chosen stage, stage epoch, actual update, author display epoch
best-local checkpoint descriptor used at transition
actual local/global elapsed update counters separate from rewound Adam steps
transition_RNG: Image stores RNG for portable restart/replay; native local-to-global transition restores model+Adam but intentionally preserves live end-of-local RNG, because author logger.load_model does not restore RNG.
portable_replay: Fresh construction consumes RNG only before restore; strict restoration of all tensor/mutable/RNG/mode/grad/permission state; compare full eval logits then same real next FIT update against a live cloned model+optimizer with shared references preserved. Compare loss and complete post-step state bitwise logical bytes, including signed zero and tensor dtype/shape.
scope: Two replay branches are qualified in both local and global stages; isolated probes are charged and never alter selected scientific checkpoints or canonical fits. Selected-local final restoration must also be tested.
on_failure: Immutable failure receipt and trace; no silent reconstruction, partial state load, float tolerance rescue, flag guess or scientific retry.
